title: Does SF rent control apply?
rule: SF rent increase limits generally cover units in buildings with a first certificate of occupancy before June 13, 1979. Single-family homes and condos are generally exempt from the increase limits under state law (Costa-Hawkins), with exceptions. Eviction protections can apply even where increase limits do not.
notes: Year built from DataSF Assessor data is a proxy for certificate of occupancy date.
